The required solution will support financial accounting, accounts payable and receivable, purchase-to-pay processes, budgeting and forecasting, project, grant and fund management, publications stock management, reporting, audit trails, document management, electronic approvals and supported integration or data exchange with relevant external systems. The contract will be awarded for a fixed term of five years.
